root_cause: The default Worker grants permit finding and activity search, not fact search. The role-filtered enum rejected types[0]. The keyword, limit, and mixed-search implementation are valid. This is an authorization restriction with ambiguous diagnostics, not a reason to grant additional access.
changes: Generic enum errors list bounded schema choices without echoing rejected input.
context_search validates its final role schema at both hook and execution boundaries, independently of finding-traffic binding and direct/deferred dispatch.

The tool description no longer names fact/finding/intent as generic defaults for every role; it refers to the actual scope-specific types description. Fixed guidance explicitly limits mixed queries to the current enum.
permissions: No defaults, bindings, saved grants or migrations changed. All requested types must be authorized; unauthorized types are never silently removed. Explicitly authorized fact/finding mixed queries still succeed. Revoked assets and unrelated tasks remain inaccessible.
regressions: TestWorkerContextSearchThroughSDK: 8 combinations of default/explicit fact permission, traffic binding on/off, direct/deferred; four searches each, including the exact reported request, allowed finding search, omitted types and cross-task denial. Revoked and foreign-task findings are excluded.

verification.environment: PostgreSQL 17 disposable container series-worker-context-review-20261026 on 127.0.0.1:15439; separate package databases with explicit SERIES_PG_DSN; simulated local model only.
verification.red_tests: The diagnostic and role-description regression tests failed before the fixes.
verification.intermediate_failure: Initial validation wrapping also changed when legacy asset_search rejects a missing selector. Limited the new preflight wrapper to context_search; the unchanged asset migration regression and full Server suite then passed.

limits: Real models are guided by the clarified schema; tests do not guarantee they never request an unauthorized type.
Existing Planner review edits were preserved. No Git commit, production database mutation, service restart or SDK change.

Worker still needs an explicit fact search grant to search fact; without it, use finding search or permitted context_get reads of known references. Backend rebuild/restart is needed to apply code changes.
